question: Can one deterministic reference-support cascade recover consumed PV28 after native SAM support produced zero cycles while preserving both cross-scene rejections?

predecessor.single_change: When the native reference SAM support contains zero coherent cycle pixels, request the already-frozen reference bound extent as a high-recall support specialist. Keep view pair, matcher, cycle, affine extent, query support and all gates unchanged.

reference_binding.support_surface: Native SAM2 reference support first; frozen reference bound extent only on zero native cycles.
reference_binding.extent_surface: The same frozen reference bbox is transported independently to every query.
reference_binding.query_truth_isolation: Positive query bbox opens only after transport; negatives receive no exact-target query truth.

proposal.transport: Unchanged full-frame symmetric RoMa, bilateral 0.05 certainty, in-bounds target, 0.013888888888888888 round-trip error, largest 8-connected reference cycle component, ordinary affine fit and bound-extent transport.
proposal.reference_support_cascade: Native SAM support; only on exactly zero reference cycles, use frozen reference bound extent support once.
proposal.component_tie_break: Maximum area then lowest label; no fallback.
proposal.mask: One native reference and query SAM2 mask; reference bound extent is support-only specialist, never query evidence.
proposal.query_extent: Transported bbox; query SAM mask is support only.

matcher.absolute_support: Frozen cycle opportunity plus dominant-component majority; global purity remains diagnostic only.

evaluation.negative_authority: Different physical 3RScan reference families cannot contain exact target PV28.

forbidden_after_freeze: change views, models, cycle, component, affine extent, query support or gates
invoke the bound-extent specialist for any reason other than exactly zero native reference cycles
use query truth to select support or repair transport
retry, replace or remove a failed pair
implementation_correction: The first attempted wrapper call terminated before a result because its specialist support hash was absent from the extent map. V2 maps the frozen bound support hash to the identical bound transport surface; no model, data, view, threshold or decision rule changed.
claim_boundary: This is a one-change consumed-source Development test of reference-support deferral on PV28 and two fixed target-absent controls. It is not confirmation, arbitrary sibling rejection, provider independence, raw-camera binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, benefit, reliability or safety.
